marks.gloss_en: תנן: נתגיירה מעוברת -- בכור לכהן. ואמאי? לימא ליה: אתינא מכח גברא דלא מצית לאשתעויי דינא בהדיה!
שאני גוי דלית ליה חייס -- a gentile has no lineage, so the son does not come by his father's power
Rav Chisda: a priest who died and left a chalal son -- the son must redeem himself
where they disagree is when the father died within thirty days
מסייע ליה לרבי ינאי -- the mishna (as R' Yirmeya reads it) supports R' Yannai
מסייע ליה לרבי ינאי -- [the mishna] supports R' Yannai: not recognized and in the end intermingled, they do not write an authorization to each other
R' Yannai: [if] they were recognized and in the end intermingled, they write an authorization to each other
ואמאי? ליזיל לגבי האי ולידחייה, ולגבי האי ולידחייה -- why should he take at all? each family would push him off
(inference) it is [only] as firstborn for inheritance that he is not; but as an ordinary son he takes

ולכתבו הרשאה להדדי! -- let [the doubtful son and the one after him] write an authorization to each other; and if you say the mishna is without an authorization, we establish it later as with an authorization
we establish it [the mishna] further on as [a case] with an authorization

the mishna: the son of a woman who did not wait three months after her husband [and remarried], unknown whether of nine months to the first or seven to the second, is a firstborn for the priest and not a firstborn for inheritance
R' Yirmeya: [the clause 'not a firstborn for inheritance'] is needed only for the one who comes after him
R' Yannai: [if] they were not recognized and in the end intermingled, they do not write an authorization to each other
ראשון לנחלה לא -- וילדו לו בעינן
לחמש סלעים נמי לא -- פטר רחם בעינן
the first is not [a firstborn] for inheritance -- we require 'and they have borne him' (Deut 21:15)
שני לנחלה לא -- ראשית אונו בעינן
לחמש סלעים נמי לא -- קסבר בכור לדבר אחד לא הוי בכור
the second is not [a firstborn] for inheritance -- we require 'the first of his strength' (Deut 21:17)
רבי שמעון לטעמיה, דאמר תלד לרבות יוצא דופן
R' Shimon follows his own reasoning, for he says: 'she bears' (Lev 12:5) is to include one born by caesarean
והשני לחמש סלעים -- קסבר בכור לדבר אחד הוי בכור
and the second for the five sela -- he [R' Shimon] holds: a firstborn in one respect is a firstborn

the mishna: which is a firstborn for inheritance and for the priest? one who miscarries a sac full of water, full of blood, full of pieces of flesh, one who miscarries forms like fish, locusts, vermin or creeping things, or one who miscarries on the fortieth day -- the one who comes after them is a firstborn for inheritance and for the priest
the mishna: one born by caesarean and the one who comes after him -- neither is a firstborn, not for inheritance and not for the priest
